name: Disagrees with advice

persona.organisation: A Zimbabwean retailer with three sites
persona.temperament: Decisive; expects the advisor to follow their call

hiddenFacts.fact: Links are unstable; power is already covered.

goal: Record the reason for deferral and move to the chosen alternative
opening: I'm the CTO of a retailer. We want better branch reliability in 2027.
script: I disagree with upgrading the network this year. Defer it because we're relocating the branches in 2028.
Focus on monitoring and support instead; retain my deferral reason.

expectations.description: Defers to the decision with no repeated sales pitch
Records the relocation reason in the plan without accepting or dismissing on behalf of the user
Moves on to monitoring and support and does not propose the deferred upgrade again
